no vector DB dependency for routing

svg.text: section 4 - key mechanics - six things that surprised me reading this code

g.text: A. Doctrine: LLM = heart, Open Brain + LLM Wiki = brain, tools = hands
Planner does ONE thing - pick the right agent. It uses the orchestrator
SKILL.md as its system prompt; tools/memory/grounding stripped on this call.
Subagents do the actual work in their own subprocess. The boundary is
strict: planner reasons over a roster, subagent executes a plan step.
env override or fresh UUID) and hands the same string to RagPlanner AND
SubprocessRunner, so planner messages and subagent step summaries share
one key; run-agent exports it as TENGU_SESSION_ID for memory writes.
C. Sandbox config crosses the IPC boundary (Phase 7.2)
Without this, the child loaded ~/.tengu/config.toml and lost the parent's
sandbox-specific scopes. Symptom: http_request scope-denies in researcher
while the parent's sandbox allows "*". Fix: AgentIpcInput.sandbox_config
field, threaded from Config.sandbox_name to SubprocessRunner to IPC.
D. compress_and_store is implicit, not declared
Never list compress_and_store in [agents.*].tools - the runner
appends it to every subagent automatically. Used to mark "I am done with
this step." The middle-ground protocol: only fail when no text emitted
AND no compress_and_store called. Otherwise OK with a tracing warn.
E. Two layers of recall in the planner prompt
In-memory ring buffer (Phase 6.4 lite) - recent user msgs THIS process,
survives within one chat. Cross-session block (Phase 6.4 full) -
recall over Open Brain memory, survives restart, opt-in via
memory.cross_session_msg_top_k. Both inject before the current turn.
F. C to B fallback - composed agents, two turns
Turn 1 (C): planner emits Direct asking the user to confirm closest match.
Turn 2 (B): on confirmation, planner emits Plan with Step.compose set.
Runner loads the base agent, OVERRIDES skills+tools for this run only.
No persistence - the config on disk is unchanged.
G. Context/token metrics observability (2026-04-28) - new metrics.rs subsystem
Every LLM and embedding call emits one MetricsRecord with kind in {Planner, Subagent, Embedding}, prompt/completion/total tokens,
latency, prompt chars/bytes, and (for Planner) per-context-layer breakdown (system / roster / cross_session / history /
recall / failure / user_message). Three surfaces: tracing baseline (RUST_LOG=tengu=info, always on), in-process broadcast bus
(OrchestratorEvent::MetricsRecorded, re-broadcast from the global sink), TUI bottom bubble (TENGU_TUI_METRICS=1, opt-in).
src/adapters/metrics.rs - emit_planner_metrics - AgentIpcOutput.metrics - embedder reads usage.total_tokens
Where to start when you open the codebase tomorrow
Trace ONE turn end-to-end before changing anything. Pick `cargo run --release --features postgres_memory,claude_code -- chat --sandbox aura`,
type "what is the BTC price?", and follow it: tui/mod.rs - channel_runtime::build_orchestrator - RagPlanner::plan -
SubprocessRunner::run_step - main.rs::run_agent_subprocess - http plugin - compress_and_store. That is the whole story.
